Earth-Moon periodic orbits (CR3BP)

Orbits computed by the differential corrector and continuation in badrelsayedNYU/cislunar-orbits and validated against the JPL Three-Body Periodic Orbit catalog (see RESULTS.md). Rotating frame centred on the Moon, thousands of km. Drag to rotate; hover over an orbit for its period, Jacobi constant, stability index and apses.

Families

Pick a family with the menu. 24 evenly spaced members of each family are shown, darker along the continuation.

9:2 synodic-resonant NRHO

The L2 southern halo member with period (2/9) × 29.530589 d = 6.5624 d, solved in the CR3BP with two sets of characteristic quantities. Both are CR3BP results; the perilune radius depends on which set is used. Published: about 3150 km (Zimovan, Howell & Davis 2017, CR3BP, read from a figure); 3196–3557 km, mean 3366 km (Lee 2019, ephemeris model).
